details: Following a significant security incident where approximately $6.3 billion was drained from the exchange, Binance has announced it will cover all losses using company funds, assuring users that their assets were never touched. The exchange has also published new Proof of Reserves snapshots and plans full zero-knowledge proofs. North Korea's Lazarus Group is suspected of being behind the attack.
title: Binance Covers $6.34B Hack, Assures User Funds Are Safe

details: Ethereum (ETH) is trading with bullish momentum, rising 1.2% to $2,271 today, and outperforming Bitcoin, which saw a 0.51% increase. The ETH/BTC exchange rate rose 0.79% over the past 24 hours. This comes despite recent U.S. spot Ethereum ETF outflows, suggesting sustained upward pressure with whales actively staking ETH.
title: Ethereum Holds Strong Amid Bullish Trend, Outperforms BTC

details: Hyperliquid (HYPE) experienced a significant surge, rising 13-20% after Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), the owner of the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), announced its plans to develop U.S. regulated perpetual futures markets utilizing Hyperliquid's infrastructure. This institutional endorsement highlights Hyperliquid's growing importance in the regulated crypto derivatives space.
title: Hyperliquid Jumps on ICE Partnership for US Futures Markets

details: Injective (INJ) saw a 5.45% increase in its price over the last 24 hours, driven by the filing of a Staked INJ ETF for listing on Nasdaq. The proposed ETF aims to stake 90% of its holdings, with the Injective Foundation intending to purchase $15 million in shares, signaling strong backing and potential for broader institutional adoption.
title: Injective (INJ) Price Jumps on Nasdaq Staked ETF Filing

details: Stablecoin issuer Tether announced a strong third-quarter profit of $1.5 billion, further bolstering its financial position. The company's reserve buffer is now approaching $8 billion, indicating robust backing for its USDT stablecoin and demonstrating continued financial stability amidst market fluctuations.
title: Tether Posts $1.5B Q3 Profit, Reserve Buffer Nears $8B
